critical_code_review_comments: tenant-debts remind: For tenant FOAD@FOAD the Resend provider rejects the address with 'Invalid `to` field' because FOAD@FOAD lacks a TLD. Backend correctly returns delivered:false with no exception — but consider adding stricter email validation at tenant-creation time (Pydantic EmailStr) so SaaS-admin cannot create tenants with invalid emails that silently fail every future notification.

Email provider note: README says provider is 'mock' when RESEND_API_KEY not set, but logs show actual Resend calls being attempted (and failing for invalid emails). Confirm RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally set in this env; if not, the mock-fallback in services/email_service.py may not be kicking in.

EcomOrderDetailDialog: when inventory.deducted is empty (no-product-id rows) confirm still shows the green status-update toast but no inventory toast — good UX. Optionally surface a small info chip 'لا توجد منتجات مرتبطة بالمخزون' in the dialog so users understand why stock wasn't touched.

csvExport.js: filename pattern hard-codes range_days '30d'. If user changes date range filter on analytics page, filename still says 30d. Minor — pass the actual range string into downloadCsv to keep filenames truthful.
